text: Design an AI autonomy transformation diagnostic and owner roadmap
description: Create a sellable diagnostic that maps company mission, owner constraints, value streams, recurring decisions, dependencies, data/access boundaries, failure costs, and unit economics. Rank candidate automation loops by economic value, reversibility, evidence availability, and supervision burden. Leave the owner with a useful inspectable aim graph even if no further engagement follows.
reflection: Created meta/ai-autonomy-transformation-diagnostic.md. It operationalizes the offer with owner mandate and decision rights, authoritative economic baselines, value-stream/dependency mapping, candidate loop cards, evidence-weighted ranking, readiness gates, staged rollout, owner handoff, and Aimparency's own real margin/reuse/concentration survival metrics. It explicitly excludes synthetic revenue, mock credits, and activity metrics. Verification: git diff --check passed; required evidence, cost, reversibility, stop, reuse, and client-dependency fields are present.

status.comment: Reusable owner diagnostic and roadmap are written and internally checked; awaiting user acceptance.
